scope: Expo React Native source checks and Android/iOS Hermes plus web export. Browser flow verification is recorded separately. No signed native binary, emulator, physical installation or audible device speech was tested.

coverage: 13 complete UTF-8 dictionaries and English fallback
Matching device voice and no-voice fallback
Never-resolving voice provider reaches translated audio failure after a bounded deadline
Location cancellation and late permission/subscription races
Stale, inaccurate, invalid and future fixes
Exact coordinates outside India without region inference
Bounded location failures and coordinate clearing

npm_audit.note: Findings include the Expo/router dependency chains for uuid/xcode and decode-uri-component/query-string. npm proposes breaking downgrades to Expo 46 / Router 5; no forced downgrade or unverified override was applied. Reassess updated compatible dependencies before deployment.

limitations: The loopback API URL in these verification bundles is for this computer; a physical phone requires a reachable configured host and a rebuilt bundle.
Translations are drafts requiring native-speaker review before public warning use.
Voice presence does not guarantee offline availability or audible output. Physical iOS silent mode can suppress speech.
The app exposes practice messages and synthetic research output; no live official alert feed or push dispatch is connected.
Android SDK, adb/emulator and an iOS build environment were unavailable. Native bundle export is not an APK/AAB/IPA build.
tooling_note: The local user npm allow-scripts setting was propagated by npx into a project install and caused EALLOWSCRIPTS. SDK-compatible additions used the installed Expo CLI directly. SDK57 navigation hooks import from expo-router, following its official SDK55-to56 migration guidance.
layout_followup: Bottom navigation now reserves item/label space plus safe-area bottom padding, scaled for larger text. Typecheck and lint rerun with exit 0; Android/iOS/web export rerun with exit 0. Unit and dependency checks unchanged.

location_followup.configuration_introspection: Passed: iOS when-in-use only; Android coarse/fine; no background location, location foreground-service or motion permissions added.
